title: did:webvh as the multi-device credential for interop with mls-rs
description: Promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok in Mark's email of 2026-11-18 (IETF notes/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-sent.md). Part (b). did:webvh credentials are per device by construction (distinct leaves, one DID log), which avoids mls-rs's duplicate-BasicCredential refusal. Check: mls-rs carries the credential (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.8: one opaque<V>; mls-rs decodes mimid KeyPackages), and a two-device did:webvh user shares a group with an mls-rs client; document the mls-rs side's needs.
